text:
anya: Quick sync — Orion-15B onboarding status. Target: catalog launch Fri 03/26. Three open items I care about: (1) final license ok from legal, (2) perf profile for long-context (8k) + cost estimate, (3) infra autoscale + fallback routing. Can owners ack and call out blockers?

kevin: infra owner for Orion-15B here. Ack. Need expected sustained qps and burst QPS to size pools. Also confirm max sequence length for typical requests (512 vs 8k) so we can set binning.

maria: curation/ML owner. Did quick microbench on A100-80GB. Rough numbers: p50 ~120ms @512 tokens, p95 ~480ms @512. 8k context not fully profiled yet — will run extended run tomorrow. Also we should decide on a quantized variant (int8) for cost.

sam: legal: quick note — upstream license includes a non-commercial clause in one of the weights. We need confirmation whether the distributed checkpoint we're planning to host has the exception. If not, we either request an exception or host via gated private variant. Estimated review: 48h if just confirmation, 5 business days if exception required.

anya: ok — sounds like realistic timelines. Action items: kevin draft autoscale policy, maria run 8k perf and add cost calc, sam confirm license scope. I'll collect and publish the checklist.

kevin: I'll draft policy and add fallback routing to smaller model variant (Orion-7B-quant) for surge. Draft snippet I'll use for the PR:
```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_nodes: 1
  max_nodes: 10
  target_util_percent: 65
  scale_up_step: 1
  scale_down_delay_sec: 300
```
I'll put this in infra PR #5123 and link once ready.

maria: adding perf tests now. I'll wire up evals for the 8k suite and attach p50/p95 + token-cost estimate. Will also note model artifacts for quantization. Expect results by tomorrow EOD.

curation-bot: Canary scheduled for orion-15b on 03/22 04:00 UTC. Test suites: smoke, latency-profile-512, latency-profile-8k, gen-quality-smoke. Report will be posted to the PR.

ops-bot: telemetry checklist: ensure tag model_tag:orion-15b and owner:eng-ml are attached to requests. Cost bucket: catalog-open-models.

oliver: growth/ops here — please ensure we have those telemetry tags before switch so cost shows properly in the console. Also confirm the embedding route is disabled until we verify vector-shape compatibility.

kevin: added tags in infra PR and included fallback route; PR link: https://git.internal/r/repo/pull/5123. Will also include canary rollout map: 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 6 hours if canary looks good.

sam: legal update — I've started a thread with the model maintainer. If they confirm the mirror we use is under Apache2 or similar, we're green. If not, we need the exception. I'll update here within 48h.

anya: owner matrix for this thread: infra=kevin, curation=maria, legal=sam. I'll publish the checklist after kevin's PR and maria's perf numbers land. Next async check-in: 03/21 EOD. If anyone needs to reassign, ping now. :thumbsup:

maria: no objections. One ask: can infra pin a minimum of 2 warm nodes for the canary window to avoid cold-start spikes?

kevin: yes — will set min_nodes:2 for canary window in the rollout plan.

anya: perfect. I'll post a compact checklist and create the task cards (JIRA/Linear) and tag owners. Thanks all. :eyes:

sam: noted, will follow up on license.

kevin: will get PR up by EOD today.

anya: thanks — I'll close the loop after canary results.
